settings_draft_text_color_invalid: Couldn't read {value} as a color. Use the #rrggbb form.
snippets_empty: No snippets yet. Add them under Snippets in Settings ({settings}).
settings_backup_unchanged: The current settings are already backed up.
backup_restore_description: Your current settings are backed up before restoring. If you sync, what changes and what is removed also syncs to your other devices.
backup_restored: Restored. The settings from before are backed up at the top.

draft_history_newer_hint_key: Go back to newer text ({keys}, or ↓ at the end of the text box)

settings_key_used_by_hotkey: {keys} is already used as the hotkey.

snippets_register_draft: Save the text as a snippet
snippets_register_selection: Save the selection as a snippet
draft_snippet_already_registered: A snippet with the same text already exists.
settings_folder_reveal_windows: Show settings folder in File Explorer
settings_folder_reveal_linux: Show settings folder in File Manager
settings_folder_description: Choose a folder in cloud storage or your dotfiles to sync settings and history with your other devices.
settings_folder_has_settings_description: If you overwrite them with this device's settings, the settings in this folder will be lost.
settings_folder_unreadable: Couldn't change the folder because a settings file in it can't be read.
settings_folder_link_missing: Couldn't change the folder because it, or a settings file in it, is a symlink to a missing location.
settings_file_unreadable: Couldn't save because a settings file can't be read.
settings_folder_unavailable: Couldn't save because the settings folder isn't available.
